zacharias.gloss: a Hebrew minor prophet of the late 6th century BC

zeal.gloss: a feeling of strong eagerness (usually in favor of a person or cause)
zeal.ex: they were imbued with a revolutionary ardor

zeal.gloss: excessive fervor to do something or accomplish some end
zeal.ex: he had an absolute zeal for litigation

zechariah.gloss: a Hebrew minor prophet of the late 6th century BC
an Old Testament book telling the prophecies of Zechariah which are concerned mainly with the renewal of Israel after the Babylonian Captivity

zephaniah.gloss: a Hebrew minor prophet of the late 7th century BC
an Old Testament book telling the prophecies of Zephaniah which are concerned mainly with the approaching judgment by God upon the sinners of Judah

zion.gloss: originally a stronghold captured by David (the 2nd king of the Israelites)
zion.ex: the inhabitants of Jerusalem are personified as `the daughter of Zion'

zion.gloss: Jewish republic in southwestern Asia at eastern end of Mediterranean
an imaginary place considered to be perfect or ideal

zealous.gloss: marked by active interest and enthusiasm

zealously.ex: she worked zealously to raise funds for the literacy project
